author: Ghostofbaz
quote: Brought a switch 2 just for this game and 100% worth it. Very Charming. Feels like they made it a bit easier then the original but that gives it a cosy feeling i love abd hopefully the rumours arr true and the Masters quest is going to be dlc. That would be great for adding a bit more difficulty. My preference is the Japanese audio. Breath of the wild killed my enthusiasm for the franchise but this has brought me back. Looks amazing plays amazing. Hope they do more remakes like this. Would definitely recommend.

author: Ghostofbaz
quote: Hours of gameplay and what a slog. None of the leads are unlikable. Seems the only people saying tbey enjoy it are paid or a simps.
